author: ChatGPT Pro
task: Legal UR1 frame to address plus one UP plus model STOP
stop: Exactly 128 epochs for every seed; no score-based stopping, extension, seed selection, or parameter change
heldout_policy: Evaluate six heldout combinations only after all three primary and replay trajectories have finished
offline_evaluation: After all training and replay, load the six fixed checkpoints per seed and evaluate all 18 rows; final metrics reuse epoch 128
length_cue_limit: Legal Q length and address count can reveal the target width without independently recognizing UP semantics
strong_gate: Every seed has final train 12/12 and heldout 6/6 exact autonomous generation including STOP
teacher_state: Each row uses an independent valid pre-event tree snapshot with only its target branch n=m-1; no live receiver is run over shuffled widths
student_interface: Only raw Q plus current answer prefix; only 0/1/STOP targets; no parser results, address, width, length, or profile features
scope: Protocol-response fitting and seen-address/seen-width combination holdout; not ordinary-frame discrimination, invalid-frame rejection, path grounding, semantic upgrade, continual profile state, growth benefit, or ritual benefit
